title: Canonical coordinate Hopf algebra over an unbundled field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $H$ be an affine $k$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Put $C=k[H]=\Gamma(H,\mathcal O_H)$, with $H\simeq\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Define the canonical coordinate $k$-Hopf algebra structure on $C$ to be the one obtained by transporting the given group structure through the affine spectrum/global-sections equivalence: its comultiplication, counit and antipode are the pullbacks of multiplication, identity and inverse, respectively. The scalar structure is the pullback of the given structure morphism $H\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. The coordinate-Hopf instance exposes the unbundled field $k$ as scalar type; it is the specialization of the canonical bundled-base-ring coordinate Hopf structure at $R=\operatorname{CommRingCat.of}(k)$.
